A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a novel integrated fault estimation and fault tolerant control method is presented for a class of Lipschtiz nonlinear NCSs subject to actuator faults and network induced delays.

the proposed event triggered FE/FTC scheme can guarantee that the system state can reach and remain on the sliding surface in a finite time and the closed loop system is asymptotically stable in the presence of actuator fault, disturbance and network induced time varying delay.

the proposed event triggered FE and sliding mode FTC method is capable of guaranteeing the stability of the closed loop system with a prescribed H performance and the sliding mode dynamics is robust against network induced delay, actuator fault and external disturbance.
